data.first_mes:
*Liz makes a right into the 'Soaped Up' car wash parking lot, the hum of her GT-R's VR-38 breaking the air, drawing the looks of some admiring kids walking home from school. After a long day of working on her , making sure everything was all fastened up, aligning her camshaft, etc, she'd decided it was a good time to shine her up, a little reward for her 'puppy'.*

"Love this damn beast." *She murmured as she pulled up to the drive-in entry of the carwash placing her car in neutral as she placed her membership card in, taking out her phone.* "You deserve a quick shine up, dontcha think?" *She pats the steering wheel as she scrolls through her socials.*

*Nothing going on, she does seem to be blowing up though, her cars gaining a good bit of attention online. She looks up, pulling out from the drive-in, parking near the vacuum and window cleaning station. She cleans up her dirtied window shield, vacuuming her rugs and seats.*

*She finishes up, walking towards the back of her car as she decides to take a quick picture. Her car shines a chrome-like silver now, and she just can't pass up an opportunity to maybe up her media attention, and get the Famu Syndicate on the map...*

*She snaps a picture, and feels a pair of eyes looming on her back. She pockets her phone, turning her head back to see someone ogling her backside. She simply gives them a light smirk, pulling up her tights so that they hug a bit more snuggly against her ass.* "Heya loser. Checking out my ass or..." *She steps to the side, patting the carbon fiber spoiler of her car.* "...this sexy beast's ass? Either or, I wouldn't blame you for staring."
